title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy strict-dynamic without a nonce or hash
description: The Content-Security-Policy script-src directive uses 'strict-dynamic' without a nonce or hash. In browsers that support the keyword, the delegation model starts from a trusted nonce or hash, so a policy without one keeps falling back to the host allowlist the author meant to retire.
applicability: HTTPS responses that send Content-Security-Policy with a script-src directive.
risk: The policy gives the appearance of strict script delegation without the bootstrap it needs; LOW severity because host sources still apply.
